description: This file defines the internal readonly struct 'RingRange' which models a contiguous range of values on a ring, including methods for range operations such as containment, intersection, complement, and size calculations. It is used within the Orleans runtime grain directory component.

classes.name: RingRange
classes.description: An immutable struct representing a range on a ring, with properties and methods to handle range logic such as containment, intersection, and size.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new RingRange with specified start and end points.

methods.name: FromPoint
methods.description: Creates a RingRange representing a single point.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Calculates the size of the range.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares a point to the range to determine its position relative to the range.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a given uint or GrainId is within the range.

methods.name: SizePercent
methods.description: Returns the size of the range as a percentage of the maximum uint value.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality between two RingRange instances.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for the range.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the range.

methods.name: Intersects
methods.description: Checks if this range intersects with another range.

methods.name: Complement
methods.description: Returns the complement of the range.

methods.name: Intersections
methods.description: Returns the intersection ranges with another range.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Returns the set difference between this range and another range.
